summary: DISC-002 creator-filter migration is blocked by a metadata gap. The canonical /api/search (FTS-backed GlobalSearchResponse) exposes only {kind:'profile', handle, profileType, location} for profile results, sourced from the accounts projection. Creator-only search (/api/search/enhanced) additionally derives genres, skills/creatorType/service, availability/availableForHire, and artistProfileId from artist_profiles.genres (string[]) and artist_profiles.settings (Json via extractCreatorCapabilitiesV1). accounts has no genres/skills/availability columns, so the canonical contract cannot express equivalent filters without either contract drift (forbidden for DISC-002) or a schema/projection change. The database lane owns the accounts search projection (CP-052) and migrations; the artist agent owns the artist_profiles surface whose genres/settings are the source fields.
completed: Caller inventory recorded: 7 direct /api/search/enhanced callers; 6 rely on creator-only profile data (app/create/page.tsx, app/api/discover/route.ts, hooks/use-enhanced-search.ts, components/search/enhanced-search.tsx, components/admin/band-hub.tsx, components/admin/org-team-grants-panel.tsx). One caller (app/discover/users/page.tsx) needs only response.ok and can migrate without creator metadata.

Gap recorded precisely: canonical profile metadata (lib/search/global-search-types.ts {kind:'profile', handle, profileType, location}) lacks artistProfileId, genres, skills/creatorType/service, availability, subtype, and follower counts; source fields live on artist_profiles.genres + artist_profiles.settings (Json) and accounts.metadata.subtype.
/api/search/enhanced now carries an explicit compatibility-gated header comment and shares the canonical 60/min rate-limit bucket; no behavior change.
next_steps: Add creator metadata to the canonical profile search projection: either 1) extend the accounts projection (or a search projection view) to carry artist_profiles.genres, capability-derived skills/availability (or raw settings), artist_profiles.id (artistProfileId), and metadata.subtype, via an additive migration; or 2) add a canonical-JSON column/view join consumed by lib/search/global-search-service.ts queryProfiles. Coordinate the source-of-truth fields with the artist agent (artist_profiles.settings/public_profile semantics) before applying.

Once the projection carries creator metadata, discover adds backward-compatible genre/creatorType/service/availableForHire filters to lib/search/canonical-search.ts + canonical-search-route.ts (no GlobalSearchResponse shape change), then migrates the 6 creator-filter callers off /api/search/enhanced and retires the compatibility surface.
Do NOT change the GlobalSearchResponse contract shape; new canonical filters must be additive query params only (parseCanonicalSearchRequest boundary).
blockers: All migrations must be additive and applied manually (CP-051); no supabase db reset or full-chain replay.
accounts/metadata is a search projection (CP-052); projection changes must not re-introduce a second organization tenant or bypass RLS at the data boundary.
